key_decisions.decision: Retains red rams’ skins and unresolved tahash identification instead of choosing an unverified animal species.
Retains traditional onyx with mineral uncertainty noted, and both priestly objects without anticipating their detailed design.
Chooses feet for paamot with corner alternative noted; keeps four rings and two-per-side placement.
Retains testimony as the source’s name for the divine deposit, with explanation in vocabulary rather than replacement by a generic document.
Chooses atonement cover for kapporet and retains exact material and dimensions; traditional mercy-seat rendering noted.
Retains precise meeting and speaking location plus transmission to Israel; does not turn cherubim into divine speakers.
Renders misgeret as rim without specifying its debated vertical placement; retains handbreadth and second molding reference.
Keeps four vessel categories and attaches pouring use to pitchers and bowls; exact vessel shapes remain uncertain.
Retains bread-of-Presence term, before-me repetition of presence idea, and continual placement.
Preserves hammered construction and every named part, with buds as botanical rendering of decorative knobs.
Distinguishes central lampstand from six branches and chooses almond shape modifying cups, retaining four and noting the compact syntax.
Retains both handling tools and pure gold; exact tool forms not specified beyond source categories.
